rows.grounds: in-that = tasyām (locative singular feminine of demonstrative pronoun tad)
one-should-invoke-goddess = āvāhat+devīm; āvāhat parsed as optative form of √vah with prefix ā (AMBIGUOUS surface form, possibly āvāhayet) + devīm accusative singular of devī 'goddess'
thereafter = tat+anantaram; compound of tad 'that' + anantara 'after/immediately following', used adverbially
